name: plan-review
description: Review plans as an architect, not a code reader: narrated task cards show decisions, interfaces, mockups and risks, a dependency map shows what each task hands to the next, and code is summarised in prose with the full source one click away. Approve or comment on each section; Claude answers every comment, revises the plan and opens the next round with the changes marked.

tts.title: Narration engine
tts.description: kokoro or say. kokoro: runs on the CPU on macOS, Windows and Linux; downloads about 400 MB of packages and 90 MB of model on first use. say: macOS only, system voices, nothing to download.

kokoro_voice.title: Kokoro voice
kokoro_voice.description: British: bf_emma, bf_isabella, bm_george, bm_lewis. American: af_heart, af_bella, am_michael, am_adam. 28 voices in total.

say_voice.title: macOS say voice
say_voice.description: A name from `say -v '?'`, for example Samantha or Jamie (Premium). Used only when the engine is say.
